subject: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)

Hi Neha / Laura / Vivek,

Quick escalation — Ruth Chang (Senior ML Engineer, on the Driftlytics PoC) received an external offer yesterday and indicated they would accept unless we put forward a short-term retention package. Ruth is a critical IC owning the streaming-kv cache work that is on the delivery path for our Q4 roadmap and the Driftlytics relationship (pilot -> paid) is revenue-impacting.

Recommendation (what I need approved ASAP):
- One-time cash retention: $20,000 (gross) paid in 30 days
- Time-locked equity escrow: 0.12% RSU grant vested over 12 months with 6-month cliff for full payout clause if employee remains through product milestone (pilot go-live)
- Funding source: Eng headcount underspend (Team: Serving Runtime; cost center 4302)

Attached: brief comp-case-summary.pdf and performance-snapshot.xlsx (highlights recent contributions, OKRs tied to Driftlytics pilot).

Why this is urgent: offer deadline is Monday 8/16 and Ruth will likely accept absent an offer. Losing this person risks delaying the pilot and jeopardizing the Driftlytics deal. I believe this is the minimum credible package to keep them engaged while we work longer-term with People Ops for band/merit adjustments.

Ask: Can I get conditional approval to proceed with an offer at the numbers above? If approved, I will work with People Ops on legal language and Finance on cost coding.

Thanks — appreciate quick eyes.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifying questions before I escalate to People Success/legal:
1) Is Ruth currently within market comp band or already above midpoint? (attach comp band if possible)
2) Is there precedent for an escrowed RSU with a 6-month cliff in our private deployment? We may need Legal to review the escrow clause language.
3) Any performance concerns or warnings in the last 12 months? I see you attached a snapshot but highlight any red flags.

If we proceed, we need a short written manager justification (bullet list) that People Success can attach to the approval packet. Also confirm cost center string and whether the cash retention comes with any clawback terms.

I can fast-track once I have these items — I will also loop in PeopleSuccess (complyco) for the legal template.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)

Neha — thanks, answers below and I pasted the manager justification at the bottom.

1) Comp band: Ruth is at the top quartile of band (current base $185k, target total comp ~ $250k with existing equity). We are offering cash + escrowed RSU to bridge the short-term gap that the external offer filled.
2) Precedent: We used a similar escrow clause for a Dedicated infra hire last year; Legal required a 6-month performance milestone rather than pure time-vesting. I will ask Legal to reuse that template.
3) Performance: No warnings; Ruth has exceeded expectations (leadership on streaming-kv latency reduction, and primary owner for Driftlytics integration). See attached performance-snapshot.xlsx (summary).

Manager justification (bullet list for People Ops packet):
- Ruth is the primary author of the streaming-KV cache optimization that reduced tail latency by 22% and unlocked the Driftlytics low-latency SLAs.
- Ruth’s work directly maps to the Driftlytics pilot go-live scheduled for 2026-10-01; delays would jeopardize a $1.2M ARR opportunity in H1 2027.
- External offer includes immediate RSU refresh and a base bump that we cannot match in-headcount without a full band increase; short-term escrow + cash is the least risky retention lever.
- Previous contributions show sustained impact across platform and component ownership; manager RTO and peers support retention.

Cost center: 4302 (Serving Runtime). Cash retention clause: 12-month clawback pro-rated if employee leaves within 12 months.

Please advise next steps for Legal language; I can draft the offer and coordinate with Ruth for timing once we have People Ops/Finance signoff.

—Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)

Karthik — finance is OK to fund from the Eng headcount underspend (4302) for the one-time cash portion; we need a Purchase Requisition (PR) and GL coding before payment can be issued. For the RSU grant we will coordinate with Equity Ops — ran this by them and they said escrowed RSUs are possible but will require a Board sign-off if the total grant pool use exceeds threshold (this amount is below threshold but still needs Equity Ops intake).

Action items for you (to move fast):
- Submit PR for $20,000 (one-time cash) with cost center 4302 and attach manager justification + offer letter draft.
- Fill out Equity Ops intake form (I can share link) and mark as "expedite" given the external offer deadline.

I can approve PR routing today if you drop the documents into Finance intake. If Legal needs to review escrow language, please loop them; Equity Ops will require Legal sign-off as well.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance (Revenue Ops partner)
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, PeopleSuccess <complyco@peoplesvc.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term retention incentive for Senior ML Engineer (R. Chang)

Team — People Ops reviewed the packet and we have conditional approval to proceed with the offer as structured. Conditions:
- Legal to review and sign off on the escrow clause (I have copied PeopleSuccess for the template).
- Manager to submit PR and Equity Ops intake by end of day 8/14 (Laura, Karthik — please confirm once submitted).
- Standard onboarding for any substantive comp adjustments (update profile in Workday within 3 business days of acceptance).

Karthik — please proceed to draft an offer and coordinate timing with Ruth (aim to present offer before 8/16 deadline). Copy PeopleSuccess on the final offer for legal review. Once PR and Equity intake are in, Laura will expedite payment routing.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
